name: Autódromo Internacional de Goiânia – Ayrton Senna
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Mixed Grand Prix circuit (3.835 km), clockwise, as renovated and resurfaced for MotoGP 2026; not the 2.590 km external or 1.910 km short circuits

start_finish.source: Approximate: middle of the main straight in front of the pit building, located in the Sentinel-2 L2A scene S2A_22KFG_20260920 (10 m); no OSM start/finish tag exists and 10 m imagery cannot show the grid
